data.narrative:
Lydian is a Series A climate and energy company that has raised $62.1M to date. The broader sector comprises 9 private peers and 1 public comparable (LNZA), though the peer set includes later-stage ventures such as Helion, Redwood Materials, and QuantumScape, limiting direct same-stage comparability.

Valuation analysis relies on stage-progression methodology, which applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement to the $62M total capital raised proxy, yielding an implied valuation of $124M. A peer-median approach was not applicable due to insufficient narrow-stage peers meeting minimum sample thresholds (0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier comps identified), preventing reliable triangulation via relative valuation. The Climate & Energy sector's heterogeneity and concentration of later-stage private and public players further constrains peer-based anchoring.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $106M to $143M, centered on $124M. This estimate carries material uncertainty stemming from the single-method foundation and the absence of direct peer validation. Key variables affecting realization include capital efficiency relative to sector benchmarks, time to next funding milestone, and technology de-risking progress. Further narrowing would require either identifying earlier-stage sector peers or obtaining comparable transaction data from the identified peer cohort.
